trials.claimQuote:
- Lifetime access to FlyMSG.io
- You must redeem your code(s) within 60 days of purchase

trials.reasoning: Buyers report accounts reverting to FREEMIUM after 3 months and being forced to switch plans, which directly conflicts with lifetime access despite other accounts showing an active lifetime plan.

exhibits.quote: Why is my account reverted back to FREEMIUM after 3 months? I couldn't even get the shortcuts to work on Social Media no matter what I do.
exhibits.argument: Account reverting to FREEMIUM after 3 months contradicts lifetime access.

exhibits.quote: Before we could do custom prompts and other manipulations. Now we can't do it anymore, we are forced to switch to another plan!
exhibits.argument: Being forced to switch to another plan contradicts lifetime access on the purchased plan.

exhibits.quote: AppSumo has this purchase marked as not redeemed, FlyMSG indicates "Your current plan AppSumo Lifetime Growth Active"
exhibits.argument: The quote shows the buyer's account reflects an active AppSumo Lifetime plan.

exhibits.quote: In addition, the Vengresso team has not only respected the conditions of the original LTD, but new features have been added and, from my experience in the LTD universe, that's something that cannot be taken for granted.
exhibits.argument: The quote confirms the vendor honored the original lifetime deal conditions over time.
